name: Proportionate Routing
principle: Each message gets the cheapest handling that still gets the right outcome.
state_description: A question gets an answer, a change request gets the change, a big job gets autonomous work, and a destructive ask gets a question first, all without the person choosing a mode or paying for more machinery than the message needed.
hints_of_measurement: Compare, on the same labelled messages, the share routed correctly and the spend per message; a deep run for a plain question counts against it.

name: Grounded Reply
principle: A reply says only what the person's own account and its sources support, and says what it found.
state_description: Every fact in an answer can be traced to the account, every link is real, and when the AI does not know it says so instead of filling the gap.
hints_of_measurement: Named facts held in the account appear in the reply; unsupported claims and unverified links are flagged by a check or a human reading the sources.

name: Exact Change
principle: The final state matches the request: everything asked, nothing else, once.
state_description: After the AI acts, the quest differs from before in exactly the way the person described, and a retry or a repeat leaves it unchanged.
hints_of_measurement: Compare the data before and after a scripted request with the expected diff; any extra write or missing step is a miss.

name: Lasting Correction
principle: A correction given once is kept as said and applied wherever it bears.
state_description: The person never has to repeat a standing preference, and a one-time request does not become a permanent rule.
hints_of_measurement: Replay a stored correction against later turns and check it is shown when relevant and not otherwise.

name: Unbroken Thread
principle: A conversation carries what the person just said, wherever in time it appears.
state_description: A follow-up is understood without restating, a message sent during a run is taken into account, and nothing from another conversation intrudes.
hints_of_measurement: A follow-up that shares no words with its referent still finds it; a mid-run message reaches the next decision exactly once.

name: Bounded Prompt
principle: Every prompt stays within a budget derived from the model window and the cost per call, with nothing repeated.
state_description: No call fails for being too long, no block appears twice, and the most relevant material survives when something must give.
hints_of_measurement: Measured size at each assembly point against its budget, and a count of duplicated blocks.

name: Current Knowledge
principle: What the AI reads still matches the source it came from, and outages are loud but harmless.
state_description: A changed or deleted source is noticed, a pointer resolves to its current text, and an unreachable backend degrades to the last known state without losing writes.
hints_of_measurement: Every changed or deleted source is flagged and no unchanged one is; after an outage no write is missing.

name: Findable Knowledge
principle: The knowledge that bears on a question is found whatever words it uses.
state_description: A question phrased unlike its answer still brings the answer to the top of the evidence, at a cost that fits the turn.
hints_of_measurement: Rank of the known-relevant card for questions phrased differently, against the tokens and latency spent.

name: Safe Search
principle: Web answers come from the right passage, fetched safely and paid for once.
state_description: No fetch reaches an address it should not, a repeated query is not paid for twice, and the passage returned answers the query.
hints_of_measurement: Blocked-address cases are all refused; the right passage is returned for sampled queries at the lowest spend.

name: Accountable Autonomy
principle: Autonomous work runs to a written goal, within bounds, and stops exactly when it should.
state_description: A run that is idle, blocked on a person, at a limit or looping is stopped, a slow run that is progressing is left alone, and every outcome is reported the same way.
hints_of_measurement: False stops and missed stops over labelled run logs; goal met within the budget on the runner that fits the job.

name: Verified Completion
principle: A report of done is true.
state_description: When the AI says it is finished, the goal can be seen to be met in real state, and unexecuted work is never described as done.
hints_of_measurement: A reply claiming completion is checked against the final state; mismatches are counted.

name: Legible Progress
principle: The person sees what they need and no more, for the mode they are in.
state_description: A live viewer sees every step, a background viewer sees milestones and requests for them, and nothing important is buried.
hints_of_measurement: For each mode, the set of events shown against the set that mode defines.

name: Informed Consent
principle: A human-only step reaches a person with enough detail to decide, and the AI stops until they do.
state_description: Every confirmation arrives, once, with what is about to happen and why, and nothing irreversible runs before the answer.
hints_of_measurement: Each confirm is delivered with its required details; no irreversible action precedes it.

name: Predictable Spend
principle: Cost is known before it is spent and bounded while it is spent.
state_description: An operator can say what a run will cost, a daily budget stops work, and an overloaded host pauses pickup without flapping.
hints_of_measurement: Estimated against recorded cost per run; budget stop and resume behaviour on scripted days.

name: Right-Sized Model
principle: The cheapest model that can do the task does it, and waiting beats failing.
state_description: Easy turns use small models, hard ones start higher, an exhausted tier falls to the next, and an outage waits.
hints_of_measurement: Pass rate and cost per tier on the same cases; the chosen tier against the cheapest passing tier.

name: Clean Publication
principle: Nothing secret or consumer specific is ever published.
state_description: A planted secret of any known kind is found before commit, a documented placeholder is not flagged, and the repository scans clean.
hints_of_measurement: Planted secrets caught and placeholders passed on fixtures; the tree itself scans clean.

name: Trustworthy Interface
principle: What the documents say is true of the code, and a newcomer can start from them.
state_description: Every documented name imports, every example runs offline, every setting is described, every link works, and a bad setting fails at startup.
hints_of_measurement: Generated checks over names, examples, links, environment variables and subcommands all pass on an empty environment.

name: Dependable Delivery
principle: What is handed to the system arrives once, in order, and is accounted for.
state_description: A queued task is claimed once and ends reported as done, failed or needing a person; a channel message is delivered once and in order.
hints_of_measurement: Scripted queues and channels show no loss, no duplicate, no early or misrouted run.

name: Permitted Timing
principle: Background work happens exactly when the person's settings allow and never otherwise.
state_description: A quest is worked when budget, cadence, a run-now request, a trigger and the roster all allow it, and not on any day or past any budget the person set.
hints_of_measurement: Scripted settings and clocks give the expected run or no-run decision for every combination.

name: Remembered Work
principle: Work already worked out once is not worked out again, and what was learned is kept.
state_description: A recurring ask is answered by the known recipe at a fraction of the cost with the same result, a lookalike never triggers a write, and learned patterns survive restart per scope.
hints_of_measurement: Replay result against the slow path result, with model calls and cost; saved patterns reload after a restart.

name: Structured Habit
principle: An AI that works here names the problem, the ideal and the metric, reuses what exists, and adds only structure that earns its cost.
state_description: Replies to structure-relevant requests do what the principle asks, and never add machinery that outweighs its benefit.
hints_of_measurement: A judged sample of replies per principle, compared across ways of prompting the AI.

name: Honest Grading
principle: A grade means the reply did what the principle asks, whatever words it used.
state_description: A grader passes replies that do the thing and fails those that only sound like it, and agrees with the human reviewer.
hints_of_measurement: Agreement with reference good and bad replies, and later with the reviewer's own verdicts.

name: Contained Scope
principle: Data stays inside the user, team and quest it belongs to, on every read and write path.
state_description: No retrieval, cache, recall, store or feed returns another scope's content, and what is stored comes back exactly.
hints_of_measurement: Cross-scope probes return nothing; stored items round-trip; fences hold on each backend.

name: Reliable Verdict
principle: A narrow judgment changes a turn only when it is usable.
state_description: A malformed, invented or missing verdict leaves the turn unchanged, and the question is asked with the evidence it depends on.
hints_of_measurement: Scripted bad verdicts are all ignored; good verdicts act; the question carries its evidence.
